judgment_calls.topic: Fasting glucose branch and the 3-6 / 6.1-11 bands
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: their only outputs are a fasting glucose check, rechecks, and diagnoses from fasting values (impaired fasting glucose, diabetes); no observable distinguishes a fasting from a random glucose, and a repeat measurement cannot be told apart.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Reuse Blood glucose status for fasting values (would collide with the random-glucose rules); a measure task with the procedure concept 'Fasting blood glucose measurement' (not a measurement observable).
